links.comparator_used: Guideline flowchart-only configuration (L1) in the ablation, on advanced cases
links.outcome: Tumor board concordance (TBCS ≥8/10) on advanced cases in the 11-level ablation (5 advanced cases)
links.effect: Guideline flowcharts alone reached 20% on advanced cases; case memory plus literature and contextual enrichment (L8) reached 80%. The plain LLM baseline reached 0% overall.
links.tradeoff: Similarity threshold not formally calibrated; low-confidence behaviour not systematically evaluated. When no cases pass the threshold the system falls back to plain LLM generation.
links.quote: Guideline flowcharts alone restored full concordance for standard first-line scenarios (L1 100%) but achieved only 20% on advanced cases requiring precedent-based reasoning.

links.comparator_used: Plain LLM with no tools or retrieval (training knowledge only)
links.outcome: Tumor board concordance in the ablation (15 cases) and mean expert Likert rating (Q1-Q6) across 45 cases
links.effect: Ablation: plain LLM 0% concordance (mean score 4.1) vs full agent 86.7% (mean score 9.0). gpt-oss-120b mean Likert 4.22 ± 0.063 with HemaGuide vs 3.21 ± 0.39 plain (P = 0.0015).
links.tradeoff: Median latency 39 s per case (p95 62 s) on commodity hardware. Hallucinations still occurred in 2/664 cases (0.3%), so confabulation risk is mitigated but not eliminated. Plain models showed a 'stable but wrong' pattern.
links.quote: The plain LLM baseline achieved 0% concordance across all 15 cases (mean score 4.1); the full agent achieved 86.7% concordance (mean score 9.0).

links.comparator_used: Plain LLM answering from its own knowledge (L0) and configurations lacking the relevant tool or data layer
links.outcome: Concordance by routing type in the ablation (5 cases per type)
links.effect: Flowcharts alone L1 100% on guideline cases; case memory, literature and enrichment L8 80% on advanced cases; molecular toolkit L9 100% on molecular cases. Plain LLM baseline was 0% overall.
links.tradeoff: Molecular mode had the highest latency variability (median 45 s, p95 123 s) because of multidatabase variant annotation.
links.quote: Guideline-amenable, mostly newly diagnosed cases were fully resolved by flowcharts alone (L1 100%), advanced cases required the combination of case memory, literature and contextual enrichment (L8 80%), and molecular cases depended on the molecular interpretation toolkit (L9 100%).

links.comparator_used: Single-component or fixed-tool ablation configurations (L1-L9) versus the full agent with autonomous routing (L10)
links.outcome: Concordance by case type in the ablation, with routing selecting the tool combination
links.effect: No single component was sufficient across case types. Gains were routing-type-dependent, and the full routed agent reached 86.7% overall concordance.
links.quote: These patterns suggest that the autonomous routing mechanism—selecting the appropriate tool combination for each clinical scenario—is the critical integrating element justifying the system’s multimodal architecture.

design_hint: retrieval grounding in guidelines and case memory, with silent-mode testing
